conf.comment:
cisco_asa to CommonSecurityLog pipeline.
Parses events, drops noise, maps to CommonSecurityLog schema, and outputs compact JSON.

add.name: severity
add.value: _raw.match(/%(?:ASA|FTD)-(\d)-\d+:/) ? _raw.match(/%(?:ASA|FTD)-(\d)-\d+:/)[1] : null

add.name: asa_code
add.value: _raw.match(/%(?:ASA|FTD)-\S*-(\d+):/) ? _raw.match(/%(?:ASA|FTD)-\S*-(\d+):/)[1] : null

add.name: event_code
add.value: asa_code || undefined

functions.description: Extract severity, message code, timestamp, and device host from the syslog header (%ASA-/%FTD-)
Fetch the per-code extraction regex for this code (184 codes)

add.name: groups
add.value: _raw.match(__regex).groups
Object.assign(__e, groups)

functions.description: Apply the code-specific regex and spread its named groups onto the event

add.name: transport
add.value: transport ? transport.toLowerCase() : (icmp_type != null || icmp_code != null) ? 'icmp' : undefined

add.name: bytes_out
add.value: bytes != null ? Number(bytes) : undefined

add.name: action
add.value: action || (_raw.match(/\b(Deny|Denied|Permit|Permitted|Built|Teardown|Allow|Allowed|Block|Blocked|Reset|Drop|Dropped)\b/i) ? _raw.match(/\b(Deny|Denied|Permit|Permitted|Built|Teardown|Allow|Allowed|Block|Blocked|Reset|Drop|Dropped)\b/i)[1] : undefined)

add.name: user
add.value: src_nt_domain ? src_nt_domain + '\\' + (src_user || '') : src_user || src_sg_info || user || undefined

add.name: src_zone
add.value: src_interface || undefined

add.name: dest_zone
add.value: dest_interface || undefined

add.name: duration
add.value: duration_hour != null ? Number(duration_hour) * 3600 + Number(duration_minute) * 60 + Number(duration_second) : undefined

add.name: icmp_type
add.value: /icmp/i.test(String(transport)) ? icmp_type : undefined

add.name: icmp_code
add.value: /icmp/i.test(String(transport)) ? icmp_code : undefined

functions.description: Alias per-code fields to CIM canonical names + fallback action verb
